title: The Concept of Generalized Reasoning and Its Underlying Circuitry
content: The properties and processes of general reasoning are often undefined in literature, leading to a perspective relegated at best to the boundaries of pure philosophy. It is therefore of interest to confine the term as a physical process of information flow instead. This dependence on the elements of matter and energy is the link between the human brain and the phenomenon itself, allowing for the hypothesis that an analogous form is possible of artificial design.
